contradictions.what: Rep first said Maya made the final call, then admitted Greg's signature was needed and he decided whether anyone got chosen.
Rep thought they were there to keep the incumbent honest, yet data-driven failed-payment recovery drew Greg's engagement and signature.
Rep describes the deal as 'signed' but it covers only online membership billing; front-desk studios remain with Global.

outcome_signals.what: Won: contract signed by Greg four days after the data session.
